default_policy.review_rule: One exact user-approved TokEMS origin is accepted at connection time, then pinned to the secure connection profile. Redirects and host changes are denied.

scripts/tokems-admin.js.purpose: Discover, authorize, and execute catalog-bound TokEMS administration actions against one user-approved remote instance.
scripts/tokems-admin.js.custom_url_policy: Only --origin on instance inspect and auth connect; remote HTTPS; origin-only input; stored connection pin after approval; no redirect; no free method, path, or URL.
scripts/tokems-admin.js.auth: DPoP sender-constrained access token from rotating OAuth Device Authorization credentials

scripts/lib/http.mjs.purpose: Enforce the approved origin, route-prefix allow-list, HTTPS policy, redirect denial, and bounded HTTP timeouts for all connector traffic.
scripts/lib/http.mjs.custom_url_policy: Receives only the normalized origin pinned by auth.mjs and a catalog or connector constant path; redirects are denied.
scripts/lib/http.mjs.auth: Caller-supplied DPoP headers for authenticated API requests; no authorization header for discovery.
